b1-34-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Changing the Class Day
b1-34-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos suggests moving your Spanish class in Budapest to Saturday. You do not think a change is necessary because the day you have now works well.
b1-34-01.prompt: Tell Carlos politely that you do not think a change is necessary.
cues: Say you do not think a change is necessary
Say what is good about the day you have now
b1-34-01.target: No creo que sea necesario cambiar el día de la clase. Creo que el día de ahora es bueno.
b1-34-01.english: I don't think it is necessary to change the day of the class. I think the current day is good.
b1-34-01.canDo: I can express opinions with negation and doubt.

b1-34-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Will Ana Visit?
b1-34-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks if your sister Ana will visit you in Budapest. You do not know yet, but she may come this month.
b1-34-02.prompt: Tell Meg that Ana may come, but it is not certain.
cues: Say it is possible that Ana comes
Say on which day she might arrive
b1-34-02.target: Es posible que Ana venga a Budapest este mes. Quizá llegue el sábado.
b1-34-02.english: It is possible that Ana will come to Budapest this month. Perhaps she will arrive on Saturday.
b1-34-02.canDo: I can express possibility and uncertainty.

b1-34-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Spanish Exam
b1-34-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how you feel about your Spanish exam in Budapest. You are sure you understand the grammar, but you are not sure you speak well.
b1-34-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what you are sure about and what you are not sure about.
cues: Say what you are sure about
Say what you are not sure about
b1-34-03.target: Estoy segura de que entiendo la gramática, pero no estoy segura de que hable bien en el examen.
b1-34-03.english: I am sure that I understand the grammar, but I am not sure that I speak well in the exam.
b1-34-03.canDo: I can contrast certainty and doubt.

b1-34-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Flat
b1-34-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what matters to you in the flat you want to rent in Budapest. It is important to you that it is near the metro, and it worries you that it may be too expensive.
b1-34-04.prompt: Tell Meg what is important to you and what worries you.
cues: Say what is important about the location
b1-34-04.target: Es importante que el piso esté cerca del metro, pero me preocupa que sea muy caro.
b1-34-04.english: It is important that the flat is near the metro, but it worries me that it may be very expensive.
b1-34-04.canDo: I can express evaluations about actions and situations.

b1-34-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Debate in the Cafés
b1-34-05.scenario: You are Meg. You read an article for your class in Budapest about a debate in the cafés of Madrid: is the new theatre better than the old? Carlos asks what the writer thinks. The writer does not believe it is a simple question, doubts that the new theatre is better in everything, and finds it important that every opinion rests on reasons.
b1-34-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what the writer thinks.
cues: Say what the writer does not believe
b1-34-05.target: El autor no cree que el tema sea sencillo. Duda que el teatro nuevo sea mejor en todo y piensa que es importante que cada opinión tenga razones.
b1-34-05.english: The writer does not believe the topic is simple. He doubts that the new theatre is better in everything and thinks it is important that every opinion has reasons.
b1-34-05.canDo: I can give a nuanced opinion rather than a simple yes-or-no judgement.

b1-34-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Trip in Summer
b1-34-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks if you want to travel to Valencia together in the summer. You are sure it would be a nice trip, but you do not think you have enough time. Perhaps August is possible.
b1-34-consolidation.prompt: Give Meg your balanced answer about the trip.
cues: Say what you are sure about
Say what you do not believe
b1-34-consolidation.target: Estoy seguro de que sería un viaje bonito, pero no creo que tengamos tiempo. Es posible que podamos ir en agosto.
b1-34-consolidation.english: I am sure it would be a nice trip, but I don't think we have time. It is possible that we can go in August.
b1-34-consolidation.canDo: I can consolidate the main opinion structures.
